sources.title: Trade on YOLO
supports: Documented fills use the onchain Pyth Pro price about two seconds after submission.
Earliest close is 15 seconds; automatic close occurs at 72 hours or the adjusted-profit cap.
Leaderboard ranks closed-trade realized PnL, open-and-close notional volume, or longest held position over 24H, 7D and All time.
The trade service co-signs opens and closes.

sources.title: YOLO profit adjustment and fees
supports: Winning calculation applies a 0.2 bp deadband, nonlinear adjustment, 50-times-collateral cap, and 2% win fee.
Every close and liquidation charges 0.2 bp of position size from collateral.
Profits and fees round down and losses round up to 0.000001 JupUSD.
Team-changeable settings include win fee, close fee, profit cap and 72-hour duration.

sources.title: YOLO payouts and the House
supports: Settled trader losses replenish the House, separate from JLP and without direct LP deposits.
Remaining collateral returns at close; profit is paid in full or queued in full.
FIFO claims pay one at a time and a large earlier claim can block later claims.
There is no payout deadline and queued profit may never be paid.

sources.title: YOLO risks
supports: Positions can liquidate during the initial close restriction and a trading pause.
Manual close submission does not guarantee execution before liquidation.
